text:
alex: Hey team — planning to enable the new quant_profile=int4_small via feature flag for a 1% canary to measure cost and quality impact. PR: https://github.com/redwood/serving/pull/4123. Need quick safety check and SRE guardrail before flip. Rolling window Mon 9am PST for ~2h. Metrics to watch: p95 latency, token error rate, hallucination delta on eval set, and GPU OOMs. Feature flag key: quant_precision.flight_control (values: off, fp16, int8, int4_small).

maria: @alex can you paste the exact flag payload + audience config? Is 1% using weighted routing or user-id hashing? Also what's the explicit escape hatch?

alex: payload + example curl below — we use user-id hashing to keep deterministic slices. Escape hatch is a revert flag and an automated circuit-breaker handled by SRE.
```bash
# enable 1% canary on text-gen and chat routes
curl -X POST https://controlplane.redwood/api/flags \\  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $CTRL_TOKEN' \\  -d '{"flag":"quant_precision.flight_control","value":"int4_small","audience":{"type":"percent","pct":1,"routes":["text-gen","chat"]},"note":"canary int4_small 1%"}'
```

jen: I can run the quick eval suite against our canary prompts (subset of openQA + regen samples). ETA ~30m. Heads-up: int4_small sometimes drops tokens on >1024 token outputs; I'll pay attention to truncation/hallucination.

tom: I'll add an automated circuit-breaker: if p95 > 600ms OR error_rate increase >0.5% (relative), we'll auto-revert the flag. Also set OOM detection to trigger a hard rollback. I'll create an alert channel #eng-ml-quant-alerts and post runbook.

deploy-bot: Scheduled canary rollout quant_precision.flight_control=int4_small at 1958769000 by alex. CI status: green.

jen: quick eval results (first pass): quality regression ~0.6% on our scoring (within expected), p95 latency +40ms, no OOMs, no error-rate spike. Will run long-form prompts next.

maria: good initial sign. Keep canary at 1% for 4h and monitor the following dashboards: token-error-rate, hallucination-delta, latency p50/p95/p99, and memory margins. Postback if any metric crosses thresholds. Please also include example log lines to watch.

alex: agreed. rollback command (escape hatch):
```bash
# rollback to fp16 fallback
curl -X POST https://controlplane.redwood/api/flags \\  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $CTRL_TOKEN' \\  -d '{"flag":"quant_precision.flight_control","value":"fp16","note":"emergency rollback int4_small"}'
```
Will flip at scheduled time and monitor. Thanks all :thumbsup:

tom: pinging infra to pre-warm nodes and add a 10% node buffer for the canary window. Done. I'll post the alert config shortly.

alex: final check — @jen can you post the long-form eval within the first 90m? @maria please ack the guardrail thresholds are set. If no objections by T-10m we proceed.
